【單字克漏字】閱讀短文〈Kyoto in Words〉，選出第 6 格最適合的答案。

The old capital of Japan, (1) ______, has inspired writers for centuries. Students of Japanese (2) ______ often walk its old streets, hoping to see the places described in famous (3) ______ works. A few days there can (4) ______ a tourist into a true fan of the city. Walking along the narrow lanes, you can (5) ______ your eyes on wooden houses and tea shops. At the end of one lane, you may find yourself standing 【(6) ______】 with a thousand-year-old gate. Among the quiet buildings, the bright red gates (7) ______ against the green hills. It is no surprise that so many visitors (8) ______ with the city and promise to return.
questions.explanation: （短文為 AI 自編，單字與中文依課本）第 6 格答案：face to face（片語 面對面）。原句：At the end of one lane, you may find yourself standing face to face with a thousand-year-old gate.　其他選項：stand out（片語 顯眼）；fall in love（片語 fall in love with 愛上）；in advance（片語 提前；事先）。
